Ari K: Proposal: two-phase 'baton' switchover for canary->main. Phase1: fast health gating at edge. Phase2: control-plane quality lock and audit handoff. Goal: reduce customer exposure while keeping fast reactions.
Priya S: Where do policies live? central or local?
Ari K: Central policy, local enforcement. Local should be able to short-circuit on clear failure (error spike) with a cached TTL decision.
Leo N: TTL duration? too short => churn, too long => stale. Suggest default 30s with per-tenant override.
Misha R: Session affinity is critical. Router must mark requests with variant-token and honor sticky sessions until explicit handoff.
Priya S: Interface: CheckBaton(tenant, probe) -> {ok|hold|reject, reason, ttl}. Also an async push for policy revocations.
Ops-Bot: Ops notes: every automated baton pass must be logged with actor, signals, before/after variant, commit, and be reversible via kill-switch. Rate-limit automatic reverts.
Ari K: Next steps: Priya write proto sketch; Leo prototype TTL cache; Misha draft ops playbook. Sync in 36h.
